142	
143	- **`@gravity-ui/uikit` MUST be installed in every Gravity UI project.** It is
144	  the base component + design-token library every other `@gravity-ui/*` package
145	  builds on; without it components render unstyled. If `package.json` lacks it,
146	  stop and have the user install and configure it first (setup:
147	  `https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/llms.txt`).

149	  assume a package is installed; never assume its major version.
150	- **Do not invent props or components.** Before using a component API you are
151	  not 100% sure of, check `rules/hallucination-traps.md` (ecosystem patterns)
152	  and the component's README in `dist/docs`. If still unsure, ask the user
153	  rather than guessing.
154	- **Never guess icon names** — they are hallucinated more often than not. To
155	  match an icon from a screenshot/photo/mock, run `scripts/icon-image-search.sh`
156	  (reverse image search). With only a description, look the name up on
157	  `gravity-ui.com/icons` or ask the user — do not invent one. Then pass it as an
158	  object (`<Icon data={CheckIcon} />`), never a string key. See
159	  `references/icons.md`.

161	  `blue-500`); never hand-write `dark:` overrides. Full token tables live in
162	  `references/theming.md`; the cross-cutting traps (partial brand overrides,
163	  a `ThemeProvider` that themes the whole page, controls on a brand background) live in
164	  `rules/hallucination-traps.md`.

166	  peer-deps). It lives in each package's root README under "Required setup" —
167	  read it once per package, do not rely on memory.

172	already implied by the rules above; this section exists as an explicit
173	stop-sign. If you are about to do any of these, stop and re-ground.

179	  read in Step 1, it does not exist — do not write `variant=`, `color=`,
180	  `name=` (on `Icon`), or a `header-3` variant. Use the documented prop or
181	  ask the user. See `rules/hallucination-traps.md`.
182	- **Do not use the `/llms/<pkg>/llms.txt` "latest" alias as a fallback.** It
183	  serves the newest major, which may differ from the installed one and have a
184	  different API. The versioned online fallback is the major-line URL
185	  (`/llms/<pkg>/<major>/llms.txt`); below that, go LOCAL.

187	  selection, focus, links and contrast on the default accent — a mismatched
188	  UI. Override the full brand token set, on each theme you support.
189	- **Do not override internal markup with `[class*='…']` / ID selectors.**
190	  That's written against one DOM structure and breaks silently when the
191	  component changes. Climb the customization ladder
192	  (global token → component CSS API → narrow flagged hack) before ever
193	  touching structure.

196

198	
199	- `references/package-routing.md` — offline snapshot of the ecosystem catalog
200	  (`gravity-ui.com/llms.txt`), refreshed each skill release. Used as the
201	  offline fallback in Step 0.
202	- `references/theming.md` — verbatim copy of uikit's `docs/theming.md`:

204	  themes, `uikit-themer`. The bundled copy may lag — read
205	  `node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/theming.md` for the
206	  version-matched file.
207	- `references/layout.md` — verbatim copy of uikit's `docs/layout.md`:
208	  spacing scale (`--g-spacing-*`), `Flex`/`Box`, `Row`/`Col`/`Container`
209	  grid, breakpoints, `useLayoutContext`.
210	- `references/icons.md` — finding an icon by image
211	  (`scripts/icon-image-search.sh`) or on gravity-ui.com/icons; the
212	  object-vs-string rendering rule.
213	- `rules/hallucination-traps.md` — Incorrect/Correct pairs for the most
214	  commonly invented APIs: typography variants (`header-3..6` don't exist, no
215	  `Heading`), the flex contract (`min-width:0`, who shrinks), theming traps
216	  (partial brand overrides, a `ThemeProvider` that themes the whole page, customization
217	  ladder), `Button view` not `variant`, `Icon data` not `name`. Per-component
218	  traps live in each package's `dist/docs`, not here.

See [Axis types](../axes/axis-types.md). ## Series options ### Markers Set `marker.enabled: true` to keep point markers visible. Configure their hover radius, border color, and border width through `series.options.line.states.hover.marker`. Hover styles apply to both always-visible and hover-only markers. The normal appearance returns when hover moves to another point or leaves the chart. Set `states.hover.enabled: false` to keep always-visible markers unchanged while retaining hover-only markers. Set `states.hover.marker.enabled: false` to disable both marker hover styles and hover-only markers. Area and area-range series support the same options under their respective series keys.
Use [axis padding](../axes/index.md#axis-padding) to fit markers at free axis limits. ### Line interpolation By default, lines connect points with straight segments. Set `interpolation: {type: 'monotone'}` to draw a smooth curve through the points without introducing new extrema. Order points monotonically by X. Markers, tooltips, and interactions stay attached to the original points.
For a cardinal spline, set `interpolation: {type: 'cardinal', tension: 0.5}`. The `tension` ranges from `0` (default, a loose curve) to `1` (straight segments). Below `1`, the curve can overshoot the data extrema and be clipped at the plot boundary. Both curves preserve `nullMode`: gaps and zero-fills are applied before interpolation. Виджет собран: один `VisualizationWidget` с переключателем «Продажи / Мониторинг», оба движка подгружаются лениво. Typecheck и unit-тесты проходят, production-сборка тоже. В браузере я ничего не запускал: по гайду skill dev-сервер без запроса не поднимаю.

**Что сделано**

- `src/widget/VisualizationWidget.tsx` — виджет: заголовок, `SegmentedRadioGroup` для режима, `Suspense` с `Loader` на время загрузки движка. Поддерживает controlled (`mode` + `onModeChange`) и uncontrolled (`defaultMode`) режимы.
- Единый API: и режим `sales`, и `monitoring` получают одинаковые пропсы `title`, `data`, `height`. `data` — это `Record<WidgetMode, TimeSeries[]>`, где у обоих режимов одна и та же форма точек `{t, v}`.
- `engines/SalesLineChart.tsx` — `@gravity-ui/charts`, datetime line chart.
- `engines/MonitoringTimeSeries.tsx` — `@gravity-ui/yagr/react`, канвасный плотный ряд.
- `transform.ts` — чистые адаптеры модели в конфиги движков (без runtime-импортов библиотек). `transform.test.ts` — 6 тестов.
- `src/demo/data.ts` — детерминированные демо-данные: 365 дней продаж по двум каналам и 3 хоста по 21 600 точек (1 с, 6 ч) с разрывом на host-3.
- `src/App.tsx` — подключение виджета с демо-данными.

**Проверки**

- `tsc --noEmit` — exit 0.
- `vitest run` — 6/6 проходят.
- `vite build` — движки разнесены в отдельные чанки: `SalesLineChart` 772 kB (249 kB gzip), `MonitoringTimeSeries` 114 kB (45 kB gzip). В entry-чанке (180 kB) нет ни uPlot, ни charts, и в `index.html` нет preload для движков. Чанк charts даёт предупреждение Vite о размере >500 kB.

**Решения, которые стоит проверить**

- Версии закреплены точно: `@gravity-ui/charts@1.73.0` и `@gravity-ui/yagr@5.3.1`. Charts 2.x требует `@gravity-ui/uikit ^8`, а проект на 7.43.0. Последняя версия charts с peer `^7` — 1.73.0.
- Для yagr локальных docs в пакете нет, поэтому API сверял по `.d.ts` и онлайн-докам `llms/yagr/5/llms.txt`. Таймлайн yagr задан в миллисекундах (`timeMultiplier: 1`).
- Режим `monitoring` — yagr, потому что каталог skill относит yagr к плотным realtime-рядам, а charts — к обычным бизнес-графикам.
- Добавил скрипт `test` в `package.json`.
- Артефакт `dist/` от проверочной сборки удалил.

**Не проверено**

- Внешний вид в light/dark, узкие (~375px) и широкие (~1400px) экраны, пустые и загрузочные состояния. Эти пункты нужно проверить вручную или запустить dev-сервер, если хочешь визуальную проверку.
- npm сообщил о 5 уязвимостях в дереве зависимостей после установки. Я их не разбирал.

Если нужен один датасет для обоих режимов, структура `data` меняется одной строкой в демо, а на API виджета это не влияет.
